planets.name: K2-232 c
planets.description: Planet of K2-232 found by radial velocity, with a 1950-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: K2-232 c was found in 2026 by Multiple Facilities by radial velocity; it does not cross its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-232. Its orbit, tilt included, follows Ranshaw et al. 2026's fit, and its size is the archive's model from its mass.
